ultrathink_gate.selected_architecture: Patch the existing skill in place: compose existing build, visual QA and semantic QA into one digest-bound, non-compensatory final customer-presentation quality gate; add only targeted renderer/model/visual corrections needed to eliminate observed first-pass failure modes.
ultrathink_gate.strongest_counterargument: A stronger invocation prompt could improve behavior without modifying the skill. Rejected as insufficient because prompt wording cannot deterministically prevent PENDING QA delivery, guarantee artifact-digest binding, or reject synthetic visual magnitude.
ultrathink_gate.failure_mode_chain: render succeeds -> file existence is mistaken for completion -> PENDING QA is ignored -> clipped or semantically damaged content reaches customer -> polished appearance masks missing business value

smallest_robust_slice: Reuse current QA/renderer stack; add one final quality contract + validator + regression proof rather than another reviewer framework.
